name: Cho
bio: Cho (チョー, Chō; December 15, 1957) is a Japanese actor, voice actor, narrator, lyricist and composer from Konosu City, Saitama Prefecture. He is affiliated with Haikyo. His former stage name was Yuichi Nagashima (長島 雄一, Nagashima Yūichi). His real name is Shigeru Nagashima (長島 茂 Nagashima Shigeru).
